reading_scope: Targeted independent verification of the advisor's unresolved-constant claim, not an exhaustive literature survey.

sources.title: Yarotsky, Quasi-particles in weak perturbations of non-interacting quantum lattice systems
sources.read: Onsite Hilbert/operator assumptions; finite-volume boundary definition; Theorems1–3; Section2 constants convention; Lemma1 contraction statement; estimates14 and15.
sources.finding: The source explicitly leaves c1,c2 and the contraction majorants unevaluated in the inspected argument. No numerical admissible interaction threshold is extracted.
sources.limit: This does not establish that explicit constants are impossible; the full original journal proof was not retrieved in this work.

sources.title: Henheik, Teufel, Wessel, Local stability of ground states in locally gapped and weakly interacting quantum spin systems
sources.read: Model setup, discussion of perturbed global-gap nonuniformity, Theorem3 and boundary footnote.
sources.finding: The local-observable stability result retains qualitative constants and does not require a uniform positive global gap after the localized perturbation.
sources.limit: Its local stability conclusion cannot substitute for the workbench's requested numerical global Hamiltonian-gap threshold.
